Real Unión is not a founding member of La Liga; the white-and-black kit club that was a La Liga founder is Real Zaragoza (though its founding name was different). The "Real" club you're likely looking for is Real Club Deportivo Espanyol? No — the correct answer is Real Betis? That has green-white. The historic white-black founding club is Real Unión de Irún, but it was not a La Liga founder.
